# langfuse_annotation_queue_assignment (Resource)

Assign a user to an annotation queue using project-scoped credentials. The user must have access to the project, for example through an organization membership with a role other than NONE. The Langfuse API can only create and delete assignments: there is no endpoint to read them, so an assignment removed outside Terraform is not detected. Import is not supported.

## Example Usage

```terraform
variable "project_public_key" {
  type      = string
  sensitive = true
}

variable "project_secret_key" {
  type      = string
  sensitive = true
}

variable "organization_public_key" {
  type      = string
  sensitive = true
}

variable "organization_private_key" {
  type      = string
  sensitive = true
}

variable "annotation_queue_id" {
  type = string
}

# The user needs access to the project, here through an organization role.
resource "langfuse_organization_membership" "annotator" {
  email                    = "annotator@example.com"
  role                     = "MEMBER"
  organization_public_key  = var.organization_public_key
  organization_private_key = var.organization_private_key
}

resource "langfuse_annotation_queue_assignment" "annotator" {
  project_public_key = var.project_public_key
  project_secret_key = var.project_secret_key
  queue_id           = var.annotation_queue_id
  user_id            = langfuse_organization_membership.annotator.user_id
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `project_public_key` (String, Sensitive) The project public key used to authenticate API calls.
- `project_secret_key` (String, Sensitive) The project secret key used to authenticate API calls.
- `queue_id` (String) ID of the annotation queue. Changing it forces a new assignment.
- `user_id` (String) ID of the user to assign. Changing it forces a new assignment.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) Identifier of the assignment in the form queue_id/user_id.
